Beat/podium consensus (beat report): on track to suit up
practiceReport.beatComment: The Ravens sent Humphrey home Thursday and made him a healthy inactive for this past Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers after he made a negative comment about the city of Baltimore on his podcast. Though Humphrey is expected to be a full participant in practice throughout Week 12, Minter suggested that he'll determine at the end of the week whether he wants to make the 30-year-old cornerback available Sunday.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Lamar Jackson
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 13 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Last Friday, head coach Jesse Minter announced that Jackson was facing a projected recovery timeline of 6-to-10 weeks after requiring a procedure to address a broken and dislocated thumb. A Week 16 return would be right up against the short end of that timeline, so if Jackson has shown notable improvement by that point, he could push to play if the 4-6 Ravens haven't faded from the playoff picture. While Jackson remains sidelined for at least a few more weeks, the Ravens will entrust trade-deadline acquisition Jacoby Brissett to direct the offense.
